newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ANDERSON FINALLY SIGNS WITH BARCELONA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ANDERSON FINALLY SIGNS WITH BARCELONA.

text.p: Brazilian striker Sonny Anderson has signed with Barcelona from French champions Monaco, Barcelona coach Louis van Gaal said on Thursday.
Anderson had been sought by the Spanish club as a replacement for his departed compatriot Ronaldo after talks with Argentine Gabriel Batistuta broke down earlier this month.
Barcelona officials said they paid Monaco between 2.5 billion pesetas ($16.5 million) and three billion pesetas ($20 million) for Anderson.
"Anderson could become the soul of the team," Van Gaal said.

The uncapped striker, widely rated one of the best in European club soccer, was finally recognised by his country on Tuesday when he was selected for the Brazilian squad to tour the Far East next month.
